label_replace((sum by (pool_index) (max by (pool_index,ins,drive) (minio_system_drive_used_bytes{job="minio",cls="$cls"})) / sum by (pool_index) (max by (pool_index,ins,drive) (minio_system_drive_total_bytes{job="minio",cls="$cls"}))), "pool", "P$1", "pool_index", "(.*)")
